S.FORM: alang ray'in ga niya mki sku Byori Keng atu Sitan go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 148 buwan, 352 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 41% kyan ku 143 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 59% kyan ku 209 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, saySiyat 37%, Tayan 2%, Paywan 1%, Amis 1%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na ray'in hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na ray'in hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na ray'in hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na ray'in hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na ray'in hya' ga kaehkaba:oS. tay mkyahu' na ray'in hya' ga batbato'an. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ rajʔin ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku βjori keŋ atu [s|ɕ]itan ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa [s|ɕ]aj[s|ɕ]ijat ** tajan * pajwan * ami[s|ɕ] * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na rajʔin ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na rajʔin ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na rajʔin ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na rajʔin ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na rajʔin ħjaʔ ɣa kaeħkaβao[s|ɕ] taj mkjaħuʔ na rajʔin ħjaʔ ɣa βatβatoʔan reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
